old_problem: Available-equals-installed conflicts with reserved spare capacity; configured versus activated state and criteria-only transitions were unspecified.
disposition_reason: Spare-mode intent, two-hour stress and DC/warm coverage are explicit. Rank/channel placement, reserved/usable equation and configured-versus-activated semantics are project bindings that can be required fail closed. ED-06 and ED-11 preserve separate transitions and controlled BIOS scope.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row42 all18 XLSX cells and history2656.
Preserved Spare-specific reservation/activation identity rather than copying Mirror semantics.
Restored separate DC/warm and full two-hour stress evidence; no BIOS, power or stress action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Memory Spare reservation, transition and two-hour stress validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved spare-rank/channel policy is configured, expected capacity is reserved, state persists across DC/warm transitions and two-hour stress remains healthy.
required_package: Approved board/BIOS revision and exact Spare-mode label/value
Rank/channel spare placement plus configured-versus-activated state definition
Installed/reserved/BIOS/OS usable capacity equation and tolerance
Qualified operator/KVM, separate DC/warm matrix and known-good restore plan
Approved two-hour memory stress and ECC/OOM/thermal/power/watchdog limits
test_case.test_command: Capture baseline BIOS/topology/capacity; operator enables only the approved Spare policy. Record direct BIOS configured state, designated spare ranks/channels and capacity equation; collect complete DMI/NUMA/OS/EDAC evidence after each separate DC cycle and warm reboot through OS Ready; run the approved two-hour stress with continuous health monitoring and restore baseline if required.
test_case.expected_result: Spare policy and reserved resources match the approved map, usable capacity satisfies the equation after each transition, the spare is not falsely reported activated, and stress completes without new error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires direct BIOS policy evidence, configured/activated distinction, reserved-capacity calculation, separate transitions and complete two-hour stress. Keyword matches alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Change only the approved Spare field and record recovery baseline.
Operator owns BIOS/DC/warm operations; no automated cycle or retry.
Do not inject faults merely to activate a spare unless separately approved under RAS rules.
Abort on no-POST, capacity/topology mismatch, unexpected spare activation, ECC/SEL/OOM/thermal/power/watchdog fault.
expected_evidence: BIOS Spare screenshots and platform/rank/channel map
Configured-versus-activated state plus reserved/usable capacity calculation
Separate DC and warm transition timelines through OS Ready
test_case.recovery: If a spare unexpectedly activates, capacity changes or training fails, stop remaining phases, preserve BIOS/POST/SEL/ECC/rank-state evidence, have the operator restore only the recorded known-good policy, and require memory/RAS owner review; do not inject or clear errors automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The ambiguous capacity wording is replaced by a mandatory Spare reservation equation and state definition without losing transition/stress coverage.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; project Spare topology and state-matrix parameters gate execution.
